decisions.claim: B works at the same office as A
decisions.reason: Turn 1 'We are doing Secret Santa at the office' presupposes B shares the same office with A via 'We' and 'the office'.

decisions.claim: B made a suggestion about what to get Jacob that A agreed with
decisions.reason: Turn 3 A asks 'Any ideas what to get him?' and Turn 5 A says 'you're right. Can't go wrong with that' — cross-turn structure presupposes B gave a gift suggestion about Jacob that A agreed with.

decisions.claim: B participates in the office Secret Santa
decisions.reason: 'We are doing Secret Santa at the office' presupposes both workplace (c1) and participation (c3). c1 is the more complete claim since participation in an office Secret Santa implies working at the same office; c3 is a weaker projection of the same presupposition.

decisions.claim: B suggested a gift idea for Jacob
decisions.reason: c4 ('B suggested a gift idea for Jacob') is a weaker projection of c2 ('B made a suggestion about what to get Jacob that A agreed with'). c2 captures both the suggestion and A's agreement, making it the more complete representative.
